rationale: Secondary CD86 screen: a ~2,280-gene library (10 guides per gene, 197 intergenic controls) built from the genome-wide CD86 and PDL1 screens, sorted top/bottom 10% CD86 in one repeat. One library per bin, so the no-replicate path is used with an overdispersion pooled over the intergenic guides; calls are screening-level. Term is low vs high, the sign of the authors' MAGeCK lfc. The paper takes its CD86 regulators (Cebpb, Med12 and the Mediator complex) from this screen.
